items.title: 10.7 Redox reactions in electrolysis (electrolysis mein redox reactions) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 10.7 with Quick Check 10.4, printed pages 220-221.

blocks.text: Electrolysis ke doran positive ions (cations) cathode ki taraf jate hain. Cathode par pohanch kar woh cathode se electrons lete hain.

Electrons lena reduction hai aur yeh hamesha cathode par hota hai. Agar metal atoms banen to woh cathode par metal ki tah (layer) ki shakal mein jam sakte hain, ya cell mein pighli hui tah bana sakte hain. Agar hydrogen gas bane to woh bulbulon (bubbles) ki shakal mein nikal jati hai.
Negative ions (anions) anode ki taraf jate hain. Anode par pohanch kar woh anode ko electrons de dete hain. Electrons khona oxidation hai. Oxidation hamesha anode par hoti hai.
Electrolysis ek redox reaction hai. Misal: jab pighle hue zinc chloride (ZnCl₂) ki electrolysis ki jaye to electrodes par yeh reactions hote hain:

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki anode equation mein chlorine Cl₂(s) (solid) likhi hai. Chlorine gas ban kar nikalti hai, is liye sahi Cl₂(g) hai, jaisa kitab ki overall equation mein bhi hai.
Anode par jitne electrons khoye jate hain, cathode par utne hi liye jate hain. Overall (kul) reaction:

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Yaad rakhne ka tareeqa: “AN OX, RED CAT” — ANode par OXidation, REDuction CAThode par. Cathode par cations aate hain (dono lafz 'cat' se shuru).

blocks.prompt: i. Pighle CuBr₂ mein kaun se ions hain?
ii. Copper metal kis electrode par banta hai?
blocks.explanation: Cathode (negative electrode) par, kyun ke Cu²⁺ cation hai.

blocks.prompt: iii. Copper banne ki half-equation likhein.
iv. Doosre electrode par bromine banne ki half-equation likhein.

items: Cathode: cations electrons lete hain (reduction): Cu²⁺ + 2e⁻ → Cu, 2H⁺ + 2e⁻ → H₂.
Anode: anions electrons dete hain (oxidation): 2Cl⁻ → Cl₂ + 2e⁻, 4OH⁻ → O₂ + 2H₂O + 4e⁻.
Molten ZnCl₂ → Zn (cathode) + Cl₂ (anode); electrolysis redox reaction hai.
